displayName: VB6 form + COM interop → .NET 10 / Blazor Server + bUnit
description: Reference VB6→.NET-10 scaffold for VB6 thick-client apps that the customer wants to web-modernise. A representative form (frmOrderEntry.frm) becomes a Blazor Server component (OrderEntryComponent.razor + .razor.cs code-behind). VB6 events translate with sharper paradigm gaps: Form_Load → OnInitializedAsync (no DOM yet), control events → @onclick handlers, Timer events → PeriodicTimer in scoped services. Form-level state lives in a Scoped service, not on the component class. DAO/ADO maps to EF Core 10. Late-bound COM is flagged as Open Question because Blazor Server runs multi-threaded and most VBA-era COM is STA-bound. Picked during Discovery for codebases moving off desktop. Per ADR-036 this is the most complex of the three archetypes and ships last in 10.0.d's sequencing — engagement teams should expect MORE Open Questions on Blazor specs than WinForms or minimal-API.

matches.fallback: Used whenever the spec's target_archetype_hint is 'BlazorServer', regardless of routine name.
